parameters.command: get_allocs(){ ip="$1"; port="$2"; line=$(curl --insecure --silent --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 10 "https://${ip}:${port}" | grep -e "GxA-Cyto" | sed 's/<[^>]*>//g' | head -n 1); [ -z "$line" ] && return 0; total=$(echo "$line" | awk '{print $2}'); used=$(echo "$line" | awk '{print $3}'); remain=$((total-used)); jq -n --arg key "${ip}:${port}" --arg ip "$ip" --argjson port "$port" --argjson total "$total" --argjson used "$used" --argjson remain "$remain" '{Key:$key, "Public IP":$ip, "Çıkış Portu":$port, "total Allocation":$total, "Used Allocation":$used, Remain:$remain}'; }; { get_allocs 194.15.102.33 8443 & for port in $(seq 8443 8488); do get_allocs 194.15.102.101 "$port" & done; wait; } | jq -s 'sort_by(.Key)'
